description: Analyze business data, build dashboards and reports, and present insights to stakeholders. Write SQL queries, clean data with Python and Excel, and create visualizations in Power BI or Tableau.
Entry-level role supporting the analytics team. Clean and analyze data, write SQL queries, prepare Excel reports and Power BI dashboards. Good communication and problem solving required.
Design data models and interactive dashboards. Build ETL pipelines, optimize SQL, and deliver Power BI and Tableau reports to business users.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures and database schemas. Work with MySQL and PostgreSQL, maintain DBMS performance and support reporting needs.
Administer relational databases, manage backups, security and performance tuning. Experience with SQL Server, Oracle or MySQL and Linux required.
Build predictive models and machine learning pipelines. Strong Python, statistics and feature engineering skills with scikit-learn, Pandas and NumPy. Communicate findings clearly.
Train, deploy and monitor machine learning models. Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, Docker and cloud experience on AWS or GCP. Knowledge of MLOps is a plus.
Develop NLP solutions for text classification, entity extraction and search. Work with spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face and LLMs in Python.
Build backend services and APIs with Python, Flask or Django. Work with SQL databases, Git and REST APIs; write tests with PyTest.
Develop web applications using JavaScript, React and Node.js with HTML and CSS. Work with REST APIs, MongoDB or SQL databases, and Git.
Design and maintain data pipelines and warehouses. Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Airflow, and a cloud platform such as AWS or Azure.
Gather business requirements, analyze processes and create documentation. Use SQL and Excel for analysis, Power BI for reporting, and work with stakeholders in an Agile team.
Design and maintain automated test suites with Selenium and Python. Test REST APIs with Postman, run CI/CD pipelines and track defects in JIRA.
Automate infrastructure and deployments. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Linux and AWS. Scripting with Bash or Python.
Internship for students. Learn SQL, Excel and Python for data analysis, and build simple dashboards with Power BI. Curiosity and teamwork valued.
